items.raw_excerpt: Tại ngôi đình 121 năm tuổi phường Hòa Cường, TP Đà Nẵng, Lễ hội Đình làng Nại Nam năm 2026 có nét mới là không gian văn hóa mỳ Quảng - di sản văn hóa phi vật thể quốc gia, tôn vinh văn hóa ẩm thực và tạo gắn kết cộng đồng.
items.summary_en: A 121-year-old communal house in Hoa Cuong ward, Da Nang, is hosting the Nai Nam village festival this year. The new feature is a Quang noodle cultural space, a national intangible heritage. It celebrates food culture and brings the community closer.
items.summary_ko: 다낭 호아끄엉동 121년 된 마을 정자에서 올해 나이남 마을 축제가 열립니다. 새로운 점은 국가 무형문화유산인 꽝면 문화 공간입니다. 음식 문화를 기리고 마을 사람들의 유대를 돈독히 합니다.
items.title_en: 121-year-old communal house in Da Nang adds Quang noodle festival

items.raw_excerpt: The Catholic celebration of Mariä Himmelfahrt is a lesser known yet rather floral public holiday in many parts of southern Germany.
items.summary_en: Mariä Himmelfahrt is a public holiday in many parts of southern Germany. It is a floral celebration that many people do not know well. In Bavaria, people hang out bouquets to mark the day.

items.raw_excerpt: When your dealership is surrounded by fields of tall corn in all directions, it makes sense that your farm tire business would be very important to you. This holds true for Kuil...
items.summary_en: A tire dealer in a small Holland town is surrounded by cornfields on all sides. The shop, Kuil Banden BV, stays busy by serving local farmers with fast 24/7 service and a full inventory. The story shows how a small business grows by meeting the needs of its community.

items.title_en: Holland Tire Dealer Thrives in a Small Town
